from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the collection, identifying itself and what other provided papers it references."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
